profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at dutchie
profile.summary:
Senior UI engineer and technical lead with 13+ years of experience building engaging, interactive stuff for the web. Has helped architect and deliver high-quality websites and applications for Fortune 500 clients such as AT&T, Biogen, Monsanto, VF Corporation and General Motors with experience in React, Wordpress and Adobe Experience Manager. Currently a full-time React developer in the fast-growing cannabis tech space with additional interests in XR app development, emerging WebVR technologies, social VR, virtual world-building and 3D asset generation.

www.aelainelong.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Building fullstack features for Dutchie’s Ecomm menus and growing adtech platform, using React, Typescript, GraphQL, Node.js and Ruby on Rails. 
- Helping organize charter-wide stability initiatives, mentoring other engineers, and raising technical documentation standards

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.description: UI engineer with a focus on the order management side of Dutchie's admin application. Primarily working with React, GraphQL, Node.js and Mobx.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer & Technical Director
positions.description:
In addition to all of the previous responsibilities...
• Managing and mentoring other team members in technical strategy and best practices.
• Leading the development team in the adoption of React and Webpack for modern application development.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer & Technical Architect
positions.description:
• Lead front-end developer for about.att.com, building templates and reusable components in HTML5, SASS and JavaScript (ES6) for a variety of AT&T’s internal and external sites within Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
• Providing technical counsel and helping manage technical communications between IT partners, project managers and digital content authors.
• Training digital content authors on the AEM platform, and compiling and distributing extensive site maintenance documentation.
• Improving development workflow via the introduction of task runners and other automated processes.
positions.insights: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), JavaScript and +6 skills

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
• Architected an online newsroom for AT&T’s Spanish-language site, espanol.att.com and lead the front-end development of multiple espanol.att.com redesigns.
• Built and maintained highly visible, high-quality responsive websites for major clients such as AT&T, Monsanto, GM, VF Corporation, Biogen, and Missouri Department of Transportation.
• Developed standards-compliant static websites and custom themes for Wordpress using HTML5, CSS, jQuery and PHP.

positions.title: Web Administrator
positions.description:
• Editorial content lead for y98.com and kezk.com, also overseeing website traffic growth and audience engagement through social media. 
• Designed and implemented digital components of on-air marketing campaigns and contests. 
• Produced additional station branding and identity collateral such as interactive landing pages, van wraps, billboards and coffee mugs. 
• Also served as lead web designer and digital sales creative producer, creating digital advertisements for use throughout the CBS Radio St. Louis' online properties.
positions.insights: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and +4 skills

positions.title: Internet Director
positions.description:
• Web designer and developer for campus radio station. 
• Developed and maintained an interactive website showcasing the station's on-air schedule and online streaming. 
• Also hosted daytime format and specialty shows.
positions.insights: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and +4 skills
